title: GranDread
overview:
Listen, comrades! Now comes the roar of the giant battleship launching!

I'll lead the "Space Fleet!" to victory!

GranDread is a science fiction war simulation. In the distant future an unknown alien force attacks the solar system. Near the orbit of Jupiter, a young Space Force cadet named Nagumo is rescued by the Dragonalis, an ancient starship built by a lost Jupiter civilization, which wakes from its long sleep and accepts him as its captain.

As fleet commander, you move squadrons of starships across a hex-grid battlefield and plan your tactics unit by unit. Battles play out as full polygon combat scenes, and the story unfolds between fights in large character drama scenes, branching toward multiple endings.

- Squad-based tactical battles on a hex map
- Polygon battle scenes with a wide range of units
- Multiple endings, memory backup saves

仲間たちよ聞け！いま巨大戦艦発進の轟き！

「宇宙艦隊！」オレが勝利にみちびく！
